usageNotes: Use this to grant or revoke role-based permissions on a Proxmox resource path (e.g. /vms/100, /storage/local, /nodes/pve1). The caller must hold the 'Modify' privilege on the target path itself. Supplying delete=true removes the matching ACL entry instead of adding it; at least one of users, groups, or tokens must be provided alongside the required path and roles.

examples.summary: Grant PVEVMAdmin role to a user on a specific VM, propagating to child paths

tips: The path /vms/{vmid} targets a single VM; /vms/ (root) targets all VMs — be specific to avoid over-granting.
propagate defaults to true; set it to false when you want the permission to apply only at the exact path level and not be inherited by child objects.
Built-in roles (PVEAdmin, PVEVMAdmin, PVEAuditor, etc.) cannot be deleted — use get_access_roles to confirm a custom role exists before assigning it.
API tokens inherit at most the privileges of their owning user; assigning a role broader than the user's own permissions has no net effect for the token.
Removing a non-existent ACL entry (delete=true on an entry that doesn't exist) is a no-op and returns null without error.
